title: AI Image Generation in Hana
summary: Explore the latest features, fixes, and improvements in 3D design with Spline.
body_markdown: Hana now includes AI-powered features that expand the creative possibilities within your workflow. These tools allow you to generate, transform, and enhance images directly inside Hana, saving time while opening up new design directions. Whether you’re starting from scratch or iterating on existing work, AI can help you experiment more freely and achieve results faster.
